_metadata.title: Real Estate Absorption Velocity, Demand Elasticity & Employment Driver Compilation
_metadata.portal_name: State RERA Quarterly Project Progress Portals & Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA)
_metadata.disclaimer: Metrics synthesize state RERA project filings, OpenStreetMap office POI density, and published quarterly real estate transaction velocity.

sector-62-noida.name: Sector 62, Noida
sector-62-noida.elasticity_bracket: Inelastic (Resilient to +10% price moves due to tech corporate affinity)
sector-62-noida.demand_explanation: Quarterly absorption (420 units) significantly exceeds new launches (310 units), keeping inventory overhang tight at 11.2 months (<18 months benchmark).

yamuna-expressway.name: Yamuna Expressway Corridor
yamuna-expressway.elasticity_bracket: Moderate Elasticity (High investor demand driven by capital appreciation expectations)
yamuna-expressway.demand_explanation: Surging absorption propelled by multi-billion dollar industrial commitments and Jewar aerotropolis commissioning.

greater-noida-west.name: Greater Noida West
greater-noida-west.elasticity_bracket: High Elasticity (Price sensitive; buyers migrate quickly between competitor societies)
greater-noida-west.demand_explanation: Absorption and new supply are closely aligned (launch-to-sales ratio 1.05), providing stable volume without acute scarcity.

connaught-place-delhi.name: Connaught Place / Central Delhi
connaught-place-delhi.elasticity_bracket: Inelastic (Ultra-high capital ticket size limits liquidity)
connaught-place-delhi.demand_explanation: Inventory overhang exceeds 24 months due to prohibitive capital ticket sizes and slow luxury secondary churn.
